subject: Medford and West Medford Squares Rezoning
overview: The Community Development Board met to continue the public hearing on proposed mixed-use zoning amendments for Medford Square and West Medford Square. The board reviewed updated district boundaries and dimensional standards, heard extensive public feedback, and voted to continue the hearing to July 9, 2025.

items.title: Public Hearing on Medford Square and West Medford Square Districts Rezoning
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on proposed mixed-use zoning amendments for Medford and West Medford Squares and voted to continue the hearing to July 9th to address concerns regarding boundaries, infrastructure, and historic conversions.
